args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks – rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of v2.3.1, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build was also unhealthy in staging. The service was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, health checks pass and the error rate is 0.2%. Next step: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate had also failed in staging before it went out.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. I checked afterwards: all three regions are on v2.3.0, health checks pass and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is titled "checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks – rolled back to v2.3.0". It describes the failure, the rollback and the current state. It also says the cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before anyone redeploys it.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
